Coram : B.P. SINGH*, ARUN KUMAR
Customary Law: Succession-In respect of 'Tavazhi' properties in the State of Kerala- C After death of last female member of the 'Tavazhi'- Held: The 'Tavazhi' itself would come to an end, since in absence of a female member a 'Tavazhi' cannot be continued by male members alone-Surviving male would cease to operate hence last surviving male member cannot D claim it as his absolute property-Consequently, suit for partition in respect of the 'Tavazhi' properties by heirs of the male member, who pre-deceased the last surviving male member, maintainable-Partition.
